lastCompletedStory.title: Adicionar subcomando cam web com Bun.serve routes nativo em 127.0.0.1

nextStoryContext: The web command now owns a localhost-only native Bun.serve routes table. startWebServer({ port, cwd }) accepts port 0 for direct callers and reports the resolved address; the CLI defaults to 7777, rejects port 0, and exits 130/143 after graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current Bun docs confirm routes requires v1.2.3+, port 0 resolves through server.port, 127.0.0.1 is localhost-only, and stop() is graceful by default.
